data.long_meaning: The name Shefali means 'Goddess of Wealth'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shri' which is an epithet of Lakshmi, the Hindu goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name Shefali carries the meaning “Goddess of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Shefali usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
